feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 June 2026 12:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 06 June 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of the Irish Sea tracking eastwards bringing frontal troughs across the area.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5 falling variable 3 or less this afternoon, settling west or southwest 4 or 5 this evening. Increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate becoming slight for a time overnight.


##Weather##

Patchy rain or drizzle at first, becoming mainly fair overnight. Outbreaks of rain arriving from the southwest later tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 occasionally 7 Sunday afternoon for a time, decreasing west or northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough, becoming slight overnight into Monday.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving, heavy at times, clearing to become mainly fair Monday morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor becoming mostly good later.
